summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by CarMax Auto Funding LLC and related entities to report the closing of an asset-backed securitization (ABS) issuance. On the closing date, the issuing entity CarMax Auto Owner Trust 2026-2 issued $1.175 billion in asset-backed notes across multiple classes, secured by motor vehicle retail installment contracts. The filing details the standard transaction documents (trust agreement, receivables purchase agreement, sale and servicing agreement, indenture) and parties involved. This is a ordinary-course structured finance transaction, not a special situation.
